0022600161.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 0-3 at home, 1-2 on the road) visit the New York Knicks (2-4, 1-2 at home) for the Nets' seventh game of the season, with Brooklyn currently 15th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 4.5 games back, while New York is 11th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 0-4 in the season series, including a 93-92 loss in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
